def _get_numbers_distance(num1, num2, max_=1, use_log_scale=False,
    log_scale_similarity_threshold=0.1):
    if num1 == num2:
        return 0
    if use_log_scale:
        dist = logarithmic_distance(num1, num2)
        if dist <= log_scale_similarity_threshold:
            return dist
        return dist
    abs_num1 = abs(num1)
    abs_num2 = abs(num2)
    max_abs = max(abs_num1, abs_num2)
    if max_abs == 0:
        return 0
    diff = abs(num1 - num2)
    distance = diff / (diff + max_abs)
    if distance > max_:
        return max_
    return distance

def logarithmic_distance(a: numbers, b: numbers):
    offset = MATH_LOG_OFFSET
    log_a = math.copysign(math.log(abs(a) + offset), a)
    log_b = math.copysign(math.log(abs(b) + offset), b)
    diff = abs(log_a - log_b)
    max_abs = max(abs(log_a), abs(log_b))
    if max_abs == 0:
        return 0
    distance = diff / (diff + max_abs)
    return distance

def _get_numpy_array_distance(num1, num2, max_=1, use_log_scale=False,
    log_scale_similarity_threshold=0.1):

        log_num1 = numpy_apply_log_keep_sign(num1)

        diff = np.abs(log_num1 - log_num2)
